content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To create a go kart with a lawnmower engine, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Design the basic frame geometry on paper (2 hours)
Step 2. Research steering linkage geometry (3 hours)
Step 3. Apply primer to the steering column (1 hour)
Step 4. Install the seat adjustment rails (45 minutes)
Step 5. Remove the engine from the donor lawnmower (2 hours)
Step 6. Weld the rear axle hangers (1 hour)
Step 7. Source a centrifugal clutch (4 days)
Step 8. Purchase square steel tubing (3 hours)
Step 9. Tighten the throttle cable clamps (10 minutes)
Step 10. Clean the lawnmower engine carburetor (1 hour)
Step 11. Cut the side rail tubing to length (30 minutes)
Step 12. Mount the engine to the frame (1 hour)
Step 13. Measure the distance for the drive chain (20 minutes)
Step 14. Level the workbench for welding (30 minutes)

Step 16. Weld the floor pan to the chassis (2 hours)
Step 17. Build the main rectangular chassis base (4 hours)
Step 18. Deburr all cut metal edges (2 hours)
Step 19. Sketch the front spindle brackets (1 hour)
Step 20. Order high-strength Grade 8 bolts (2 days)
Step 21. Install the plastic racing seat (30 minutes)
Step 22. Align the front spindles (1 hour)
Step 23. Connect the kill switch wiring (30 minutes)
Step 24. Install the drive chain (30 minutes)
Step 25. Paint the entire frame (5 hours)

Step 38. Connect the brake lines (2 hours)

Step 49. Mount the rear wheels (30 minutes)

Step 51. Inflate tires to 15 PSI (10 minutes)
Step 52. Install the rear axle shaft (1 hour)
Step 53. Install the rear disc brake rotor (45 minutes)
Step 54. Bolt the clutch to the engine crankshaft (30 minutes)
Step 55. Drain the old oil from the engine (20 minutes)
Step 56. Install the front wheels (30 minutes)
Step 57. Assemble the front kingpins (1 hour)
Step 58. Source a scrap metal pile for brackets (5 hours)
Step 59. Attach the return springs for the pedals (15 minutes)
Step 60. Fill the engine with fresh synthetic oil (10 minutes)
Step 61. Shorten the drive chain with a breaker tool (20 minutes)
Step 62. Install the throttle cable (45 minutes)
Step 63. Fill the fuel tank with gasoline (5 minutes)
Step 64. Buy a heavy-duty live axle (2 days)
Step 65. Measure the driver's leg reach (15 minutes)
Step 66. Order a go-kart parts kit (1 week)
Step 67. Replace the engine spark plug (10 minutes)
Step 68. Weld the butterfly steering wheel hub (45 minutes)
Step 69. Set the toe-in alignment (1 hour)
Step 70. Cut the rear axle to width (45 minutes)
Step 71. Sand the frame for paint prep (4 hours)
Step 72. Grease the steering bushings (10 minutes)
Step 73. Install the floor pan bolts (30 minutes)
Step 74. Weld the brake caliper bracket (1 hour)
Step 75. Fabricate the rear bumper (2 hours)
Step 76. Choose a color scheme (30 minutes)
Step 77. Purchase a drive chain and master link (2 days)
Step 78. Design the steering geometry (2 hours)
Step 79. Buy a hydraulic brake kit (1 day)
Step 80. Clean the workshop area (1 hour)
Step 81. Prime the frame with rust inhibitor (3 hours)
Step 82. Weld the side nerf bars (3 hours)
Step 83. Purchase a set of front spindles (3 days)
Step 84. Route the throttle cable through the frame (30 minutes)
Step 85. Test the engine compression (15 minutes)
Step 86. Weld the steering column support (1.5 hours)
Step 87. Fabricate the fuel tank brackets (2 hours)
Step 88. Find a donor lawnmower (1 day)
Step 89. Buy front wheel hubs (2 days)
Step 90. Fabricate the gas pedal linkage (2 hours)
